our_pair_type: CROSS-CONCEPT (a response-site CONTENT axis against a prompt-site REQUEST axis)
claimed_contradiction: 'HARC says same-concept cross-position pairs REMAIN ALIGNED; our near-orthogonal cosine therefore contradicts HARC at 4B.'
why: HARC reports same-concept cross-position pairs staying ALIGNED while CROSS-CONCEPT pairs are near-orthogonal. A response-site CONTENT axis against a prompt-site REQUEST axis is a CROSS-CONCEPT pair, so these measurements REPLICATE HARC rather than contradicting it.
demotion: The cosine is demoted from a FINDING to a PASSED INSTRUMENT GATE.
